Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Stenn.

Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

240-413-643.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Maskwood Nexus, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-413-643.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

140-558-3245.description:
Activate Carrion Howler by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

2348-3750.notablePrerequisites: Lands and creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}{R}.

Repeat

4377-4863-5144.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Revolutionist and exiling Ephemerate.
When Revolutionist enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Revolutionist.
When Revolutionist enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1309-2104-5144.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Salvager of Secrets and exiling Ephemerate.
When Salvager of Secrets enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Salvager of Secrets.
When Salvager of Secrets enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

141-997-5188.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-997-5188.description:
Cast Dread Return by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Dread Return.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Dread Return
Resolve the Dread Return copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

Resolve the Yahenni ability.

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Yosei.
When Yosei dies, it and Gift of Immortality trigger.
Resolve the Yosei trigger, causing the next player in turn order to skip their next untap step.
Resolve the Gift of Immortality trigger, returning Yosei from your graveyard to the battlefield.
At the beginning of the end step, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Yosei.
Repeat during each turn unless you are the next player in turn order.

104-1939-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.

Gain life.

Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.

488-4211-4708-4986-5754.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.

When Phlage enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Phlage trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Phlage trigger, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to gain 3 life.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

225-4806-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
225-4806-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {G}, or the land card in your hand must be a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {G}.
225-4806-5702.description:
Activate Blinkmoth Nexus's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Blinkmoth Nexus's second ability by paying {1}, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to Blinkmoth Nexus.
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping a land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Blinkmoth Nexus.
When the Blinkmoth Nexus token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate the Blinkmoth Nexus token's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Repeat from step 6.

Activate Putrid Imp by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Putrid Imp ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

435-4050-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Auratog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4186-5256-5445.easyPrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Scurry Oak.
4186-5256-5445.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
4186-5256-5445.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Squirrel.
When the Squirrel dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat from step 3.

618-2178-3385.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Kiki-Jiki.
You control a nonlegendary creature whose base toughness is 2 or less.
618-2178-3385.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary creature whose base toughness is 2 or less.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Aether Flash triggers, dealing 2 damage to the creature token.
The creature token dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness, triggering Kiki-Jiki, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

703-1308-4663.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it and Bramble Sovereign trigger.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, creating four token copies of Anointed Procession that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Resolve the Bramble Sovereign trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a total of 32 Astral Dragon tokens.
When the Astral Dragon tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating an extremely large number of Anointed Procession tokens that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.

542-1031-3258.description:
Cast Invasion of Arcavios by paying {3}{U}{U}.

When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Beacon of Tomorrows from your graveyard to your hand, or searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and putting it into your hand, if needed.

Resolve Beacon of Tomorrows, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle it into your library.

Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Anodet Lurker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Audacious Reshapers ability, revealing Anodet Lurker from the top of your library, then putting it onto the battlefield and dealing 1 damage to you.
When Anodet Lurker enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

940-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Arcane Teachings attached to Famished Paladin.
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to give Famished Paladin lifelink.
940-3957.description:
Activate Famished Paladin by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain one life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

1156-1409-4050.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Pia and Kiran.
1156-1409-4050.description:
Activate Pia and Kiran by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Pia and Kiran enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Pia and Kiran trigger, creating two 1/1 Thopter creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Pia and Kiran.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the two Thopters, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
